notes: Pilot experiment searching for dark photon dark matter via electric field detection in 50–300 MHz range. Primary result is a broadband 5σ limit of ϵ ∼ 10^−12 over 50–300 MHz from ~3.8 hours of real-time data (Fig. 9, blue curve). Four spot-frequency calibrations at 63.9, 70.5, 152, and 247 MHz with ≥5×10^5 sec integration are shown in orange (Fig. 12), with the 70.5 MHz spot achieving ϵ = 6.4×10^−13 (Fig. 7, signal injection test). Mass values converted from frequency using m[eV] = 4.136e-15 * f[Hz]. The paper presents measured exclusion limits from the pilot phase, not projections. Future Phase-I and Phase-II projections are discussed but not included in data_points as they are forecasts. Local DM density of 0.3 GeV/cm³ is stated in the paper as the local dark matter density assumption. Confidence is moderate (0.75) because the pilot data are limited in integration time and spectral efficiency, though the coupling type and measurement methodology are clear. | selector: text (sole candidate)
